title: Sheba’s Rebellion

questions.question: Who was the worthless man who blew the trumpet calling for rebellion?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:1 (ESV): "...a worthless man... whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri... he blew the trumpet..."

questions.question: Who did David initially send to call the men of Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:4 (ESV): "Then the king said to Amasa, 'Call the men of Judah to me within three days...'"

questions.question: Who killed Amasa?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:10 (ESV): "But Amasa did not observe the sword that was in Joab's hand. So Joab struck him with it in the stomach..."

questions.question: Where was Sheba besieged?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:15 (ESV): "And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah..."

questions.question: Who saved the city of Abel of Beth-maacah?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:16 (ESV): "Then a wise woman called from the city, 'Listen! Listen! Tell Joab..."

questions.question: What deal did the wise woman make with Joab?
options: Sheba's head will be thrown over the wall
questions.correctAnswer: Sheba's head will be thrown over the wall
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:21 (ESV): "...The woman said to Joab, 'Behold, his head shall be thrown to you over the wall.'"

questions.question: What happened to David's ten concubines upon his return?
options: They were shut up until the day of their death, living as widows
questions.correctAnswer: They were shut up until the day of their death, living as widows
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:3 (ESV): "...So they were shut up until the day of their death, living as if in widowhood."

questions.question: Where did Joab meet Amasa?
options: At the great stone that is in Gibeon
questions.correctAnswer: At the great stone that is in Gibeon
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:8 (ESV): "When they were at the great stone that is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them."

questions.question: How did Joab kill Amasa?
options: While kissing him, he stabbed him
He shot him with an arrow
questions.correctAnswer: While kissing him, he stabbed him
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:9-10 (ESV): "And Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him... So Joab struck him..."

questions.question: Who was over the forced labor?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:24 (ESV): "and Adoram was in charge of the forced labor..."

questions.question: What fell out of Joab's sheath?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:8 (ESV): "...as he stepped forward, it fell out."

questions.question: What proverb did they used to say about Abel?
options: Let them ask counsel at Abel
Abel is a mother in Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Let them ask counsel at Abel
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:18 (ESV): "...They used to say in former times, 'Let them but ask counsel at Abel,' and so they settled a matter."

questions.question: Who was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:23 (ESV): "...and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites."

questions.question: Who was Ira the Jairite?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:26 (ESV): "and Ira the Jairite was also David's priest."

questions.question: Who stood by Amasa's body urging people to follow Joab?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 20:11 (ESV): "And one of Joab's young men took his stand by Amasa and said..."

key_verse_text: I am one of those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up the heritage of the LORD? (ESV)
